scope: Independent fresh-arm development continuation of C36 v7 on GH200/aarch64 after retiring the MN5 route. Two previously observed seeds, one fresh run each. The two original continue arms cannot be restored because their exact v5 checkpoints are unavailable; they remain unexecuted here. This batch does not complete or replace the four-arm MN5 protocol, and its results are never pooled with unknown old-job outcomes. Data, initialization bytes, FP64 equations, optimizer, training budget and physical limits are unchanged from the amended v7 protocol.

instance.note: the original instance of v1-v5; inputs are data/ unchanged

arms.fresh: the unchanged 4,000 Adam updates from the stored initial parameters, then SSBroyden

training.engine: compiled packed activation with analytic transpose, CUDA Graph replay (as v2 and v5)

optimizer.method: self-scaled Broyden (SSBroyden), dense inverse Hessian in FP64 on the GPU
optimizer.update: Urban, Stefanou and Pons, J. Comput. Phys. 523 (2025) 113656, Eqs. (10), (13)-(23); identical to Kiyani et al., arXiv:2501.16371, Eq. (15) and its definitions; box376.ssbroyden
optimizer.H0: identity (as Kiyani et al.; the update scaling tau adapts it)
optimizer.safeguards: update skipped when y.s <= 1e-12 |y||s|; H reset to I when a direction is not a descent direction or the line search gives no decrease; two consecutive resets end the optimizer phase
optimizer.one_matvec_per_iteration: H y = H g_{k+1} + d_k; H_{k+1} g_{k+1} carried in O(n) and checked against an explicit product at every complete-gradient check

training.maximum_training_seconds_reason: Preserve the previously amended v7 budget of 4,000 training seconds per seed. A 3 h allocation provides additional setup and complete physical-observation time on the new platform; it does not increase this training budget.
training.trainer: box376.potential_train_v7 (potential_train_v2 with the L-BFGS phase replaced and the continue arm)
training.gradient_reference: preserved full native reference at the stored initial parameters (eager, compiled, graph); dense eager parameter AD after a change, at the continue start and every 1,000 iterations

physical.state_observer: native coordinate AD of the trained curl-potential network

physical_observation.observer: box376.potential_physical_eta at eta 1/32, which binds nothing new: the unchanged box376.potential_physical
physical_observation.note: Per lane, final first; an observation starts only if the lane budget and the allocation deadline allow its estimate.

outcomes_in_order.F1_pass: at least one run passes physical acceptance at an observed checkpoint
outcomes_in_order.F2_near_miss: no run passes, and some run's complete final observation exceeds no acceptance limit by more than 1.5 times
outcomes_in_order.F0_incomplete: no pass and no near miss, and at least one of the two registered fresh runs lacks a complete final observation; no scientific reading
outcomes_in_order.F3_fail: no pass and no near miss, with complete final observations of both registered fresh runs; applies only to this two-run GH200 batch

follow_up.F1_pass: register a formal fresh-seed time-to-accuracy protocol on the original instance with this optimizer
follow_up.F2_near_miss: no formal claim; a longer optimizer budget would need a new protocol
follow_up.F0_incomplete: no scientific reading; find and repair the cause before a new attempt
follow_up.F3_fail: no formal claim at this 4,000 s per-run training budget; do not infer completion of or failure across the unavailable original continue arms

secondary_readouts: fresh runs: first evaluation at or below each loss threshold against the v5 analytic L-BFGS run of the same seed

post hoc (CPU, tools/c36_pressure_attribution.py on the final states): the pressure fraction of the residual energy and the cosine with the velocity inertia error, i.e. whether the optimizer removed the about-one-percent pressure component
caveats: Independent GH200/aarch64 execution with Torch 2.14.1+cu130, Triton 3.8.0, NumPy 2.5.4 and SciPy 1.18.1. H100/MN5 timing and convergence outcomes are not pooled with it.

Denominator is two registered fresh runs. The original two v5 continuation checkpoints are unavailable; those original tasks remain unexecuted here. Old MN5 job state is unknown after the user retired that access route.
Seeds 361901 and 361902 have been observed before; this is development evidence only, not a fresh-seed formal claim.
The amended v7 4,000 s training cap is retained. A negative outcome does not reject SSBroyden at a larger budget.
The dense inverse-Hessian approximation has 50,692 parameters; bounded rank-two updates cannot establish full convergence.
decision_rule.implementation: box376.decide_c36_v7 on box376.read_c36_v7; synthetic tests box376.test_decide_c36_v7

execution.allocation: one Arrhenius node, two GH200 GPUs, 3 h; one exclusive allocated GPU per fresh seed; both concurrent
execution.node_count_reason: two independent 50,692-parameter FP64 runs; two GPUs are the smallest concurrent allocation for the preserved training and physical-observer budgets
execution.start_command: embedded cluster-side entry runs source/runtime preflight, compiler smoke, both fresh lanes, physical observers, reader, registered decision and checked archive
execution.driver: box376.run_c36_v7_gh200; inherited scientific child commands, with the obsolete legacy Torch target shim disabled by the frozen execution field
execution.failure_archive: outer finite process-group timeout and finalizer preserve negative and partial outputs even if the inner driver fails
execution.protocol_changes: platform, two fresh runs, 3 h allocation and 900 s finalizer reserve only; mathematical objective, numerical/physical gates and 4,000 s training cap unchanged

amendments.change: allocation 3 h -> 2 h on QoS acc_interactive; maximum_training_seconds 6,600 -> 4,000; deadline reserve 900 -> 400 s
amendments.reason: the regular QoS is unavailable (allocation exhausted); user instruction to use acc_interactive, whose maximum wall time is 2 h

amendments.change: independent two-seed fresh-arm GH200 batch; retain the 4,000 s training cap and all mathematical gates
amendments.reason: MN5 access retired at user request; exact v5 continuation checkpoints unavailable; GH200 full-gradient compatibility qualified
